rows.note: Use 好 as the all-purpose colloquial intensifier before adjectives and other descriptive expressions.

example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 hou2 hou2 tai2

rows.note: Use 非常 as a more formal alternative to 好 for expressing a high degree.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fong1 on3 fei1 soeng4 zung6 jiu3

rows.note: Use 最 before a description when firmly asserting the superlative, as in “the very best.”

example.english: These egg tarts are the very best.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 ge3 daan6 taat1 zeoi3 zing3
